summary:
The Realistic Galaxy Consulting Toolkit Infographics is a collection of space-themed visual assets.
Key Features

• Aesthetic & Design: Features a galactic backdrop with pink, purple, and blue star-and-planet themes paired with a sleek dark design instead of standard white slides.
Contents: Includes 32 supplemental infographics (maps, timelines, graphs, and tables) designed to pair with the core Realistic Galaxy Consulting Toolkit template.
